outputs.explanation: Panel A shows micrograph-type super-resolution reconstructions (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) for CtpG-mEos, not a quantitative averaged plot.
Panel B shows micrograph-type super-resolution reconstructions for PacL2-mEos, not an averaged plot.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing each cell's cluster count, as stated in the caption.
Panel D shows cluster sizes as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster, per the caption and visible in the plot.
Panel E shows the proportion of clustered molecules as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots per cell.
Panel F contains micrograph/trajectory images, not an averaged quantitative plot.

Panel G top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution, not a mean summary) and bottom is a line plot (MSD traces per molecule); neither is a bar/mean plot requiring overlaid individual points, and line plots are exempt.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and kymographs (micrograph/trajectory visualizations), not an averaged summary plot.
